$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor/validator tooling.

ai.description: AI provider and model settings for each stage. When omitted, the provider is auto-detected from environment variables.

review.description: Review pipeline configuration. When omitted, a default agentic review pipeline is used.

performance.description: Compatibility settings for performance limits. In current runtime behavior, only throttling.apiCallsPerMinute is actively applied.

fix.description: Fix generation behaviour and thresholds for the fix stage.

report.description: Report output and filtering options used by report and CI integrations.

github.description: GitHub PR integration options for comments, annotations, and quality gating.

gitlab.description: GitLab MR integration options for comments and pipeline blocking.

paths.description: Legacy directory overrides retained for compatibility. Current pipeline execution does not apply these values.

logger.description: Logger behavior for console output (level, colors, timestamps, prefix). This is read from a root .qualopsrc.json file.

skipPatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from all analysis. Applied before any file reaches the review pipeline.

includePatterns.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

maxFilesPerBatch.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

maxConcurrency.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

cacheEnabled.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

cacheTTL.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

outputFormat.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

outputPath.description: Legacy top-level override currently unused by runtime stage implementations.

verbose.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored (environment variables still apply).

debug.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored (environment variables still apply).

maxFileSizeKB.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

maxTokensPerFile.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

maxReactSteps.description: Legacy compatibility field. Values from config files are currently ignored.

aiConfig.description: AI provider and model settings for each stage.

reviewStage.description: Settings for the review stage runtime. When omitted, QualOps auto-detects the provider from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY and uses the default model for that provider.

fixStage.description: Settings for the fix stage runtime.

judgeStage.description: Planned settings (currently unused) for configuring the judge stage (not yet implemented).

aiStageConfig.description: AI configuration for a specific stage.

provider.description: Deprecated. Prefer specifying provider inside the model object.

model.description: Model name or { provider, name } object.

inputPerMillion.description: Estimated input token cost per million tokens.

outputPerMillion.description: Estimated output token cost per million tokens.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature used by compatible providers.

modelConfig.description: Model to use: a string name (inherits provider from context) or an object with an explicit name and optional provider override.

reviewConfig.description: Top-level review stage configuration and job pipeline.

minConfidence.description: Base confidence threshold used by review and template rendering contexts.

maxConcurrentFiles.description: Concurrent file reviews for file-by-file pass execution.

validation.description: Global validation settings applied to all pipeline jobs.

deduplication.description: Global deduplication settings applied to all pipeline jobs.

pipeline.description: Ordered list of review jobs to execute.

sessionBased.description: Legacy compatibility setting currently ignored by the active review pipeline.

maxFilesBeforeReset.description: Legacy compatibility setting currently ignored by the active review pipeline.

maxContextTokens.description: Legacy compatibility setting currently ignored by the active review pipeline.

validationConfig.description: Validation stage settings used to filter/adjust detected issues.

enabled.description: Enable validation pass for this scope.

promptRef.description: Prompt reference as a relative path string or { file, meta } object.

promptConfig.description: Prompt reference object with optional metadata.

meta.description: Optional metadata that can be used by prompt templates.

deduplicationConfig.description: Deduplication settings used to remove repeated issues per file.

pipelineJob.description: Union type for supported pipeline job modes.

pipelineJobAgentic.description: Pipeline job in agentic mode. Passes are optional in this mode.

agenticConfig.description: Settings for agentic review execution (cross-file analysis with tools/subagents).

maxTurns.description: Maximum message/tool-call turns for the agentic run.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Optional budget guardrail for agentic execution.

enabledSubagents.description: Built-in subagents to enable, optionally with model overrides.

customAgents.description: Custom agents loaded from config and optional agents directory.

agentsDir.description: Directory containing external custom agent files.

systemPrompt.description: Additional system instructions appended to the default agentic prompt.

prompt.description: Prompt file reference appended after systemPrompt in the agentic prompt.

maxTokensPerFile.description: Per-file token budget when building agentic context.

maxTotalTokens.description: Total token budget for all file contexts in one agentic run.

bash.description: Bash tool configuration for agentic review agents.

subagentOverride.description: Built-in subagent identifier with an explicit model override.

agenticSubagentType.description: Built-in subagent identifiers supported in agentic mode.

customAgentDefinition.description: Custom subagent definition merged with built-in agentic subagents.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of the custom agent.

prompt.description: System instructions for the custom agent.

tools.description: Allowed tool names for the custom agent.

contextMode.description: How file context is sent: diff, full file content, or auto mode.

bashConfig.description: Configuration for the bash interrogation tool used by agentic review agents.

mode.description: Sandbox mode for the bash tool. auto = detect from environment, ci = CI runner sandbox, local-besteffort = bwrap/Seatbelt, none = unsandboxed (test only).

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to the workspace root. Default: /workspace.

maxCallsPerReview.description: Maximum bash tool calls per review session. Default: 200.

subagentAccess.description: Whether subagents can use the bash tool. Default: all.

extraDeniedBinaries.description: Additional binary names to deny beyond the built-in list.

reviewPass.description: Single review pass executed within a file-by-file pipeline job.

name.description: Display name for logging and report grouping.

enabled.description: Set false to disable this pass without removing it.

docs.description: Optional docs reference used to build doc-aware review prompts.

prompt.description: Prompt reference used by this review pass.

filters.description: Optional filters to limit this pass to relevant files/content.

reviewPassFilters.description: File/content filters used to decide whether a pass should review a file.

detectionTriggers.description: Regex patterns tested against file content; at least one match is required.

filePatterns.description: Glob patterns a file path must match to be reviewed.

excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns that exclude matching files from the pass.

pipelineJobFileByFile.description: Pipeline job in file-by-file mode. Requires at least one pass.

performanceConfig.description: Compatibility fields for performance tuning. In the current runtime, throttling.apiCallsPerMinute is the only actively applied setting.

maxFileSizeKB.description: Legacy compatibility field currently not applied by active stages.

maxFilesPerBatch.description: Legacy compatibility field currently not applied by active stages.

maxFilesPerProject.description: Legacy compatibility field currently not applied by active stages.

timeoutSeconds.description: Legacy compatibility field currently not applied by active stages.

maxTokensPerFile.description: Legacy compatibility field currently not applied by active stages.

maxRetries.description: Legacy compatibility field currently not applied by active stages.

maxConcurrentFiles.description: Legacy compatibility field currently not applied by active stages.

throttlingConfig.description: API rate-limit settings for review-time AI calls.

apiCallsPerMinute.description: Maximum review-time AI calls per minute. If omitted, runtime defaults to 2.

maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Legacy compatibility alias currently ignored at runtime.

fixConfig.description: Fix stage controls for severity filtering, confidence threshold, and apply behaviour.

maxConcurrentFixes.description: Maximum number of fixes generated concurrently.

prompt.description: Optional fix prompt override used by fix generation workflows.

minConfidence.description: Minimum issue confidence required before generating fixes.

autoApply.description: If true, enables automatic application of generated fixes when requested by stage options.

severity.description: Standard issue severity levels used across review, fix, and reporting.

reportConfig.description: Report rendering and severity filtering settings used by report and CI outputs.

includedSeverities.description: Only issues with these severities are included in report outputs.

generateIssueMarkdown.description: Generate per-issue markdown files alongside reports.

enableRootCauseExtraction.description: Enable post-processing that classifies issues into root-cause buckets.

outputFormat.description: Output format for reports and generated files.

postComments.description: Post or update a QualOps PR comment.

skipOnDraft.description: Skip commenting/check updates for draft PRs.

blockPipeline.description: Fail status/check when configured quality conditions are not met.

maxInlineComments.description: Maximum number of inline annotations/comments created per run.

gitlabConfig.description: GitLab merge request integration settings. This section is read from a root .qualopsrc.json file.

blockPipeline.description: Fail CI pipeline when configured quality conditions are not met.

postComments.description: Post or update a QualOps MR note.

skipOnDraft.description: Skip MR updates for draft merge requests when supported.

pathsConfig.description: Legacy directory override settings retained for compatibility.

loggerConfig.description: Logger output formatting options used by shared logger initialization.

prefix.description: Optional static prefix added to each log line.

agentModel.description: Optional model override for this custom agent.
